_readme: English text for data/addons.json, by add-on id: name, description, note and each choice's label (by choice id). Prices and images come from data/addons.json.

profile-color.name: Aluminum frame color
profile-color.description: The color of the frame and profiles. No extra charge.

double-door.name: Double door (1.80 m opening)
double-door.description: Replaces the main door with a double door – an extra-wide opening for large equipment, motorcycles, furniture and machinery.

extra-door.name: Additional door
extra-door.description: A second designer door with a lock, on any wall you choose – access from any side.

sliding-window.name: Sliding window with screen
sliding-window.description: Finally – a sliding window with a screen, made for Modubox sheds. Natural light and fresh air.

glass-wall.name: Glass wall
glass-wall.description: A double-glazed, tempered, insulated glass wall. Also available with a built-in Venetian blind that tilts and lifts magnetically.

electric-panel.name: Electrical panel for the shed
electric-panel.description: A compact electrical panel installed in your shed at the factory. One cable connects it to your home's power, and the shed gets outlets and lighting – safe and protected, with no electrical work on site.
electric-panel.note: Includes: a residual-current breaker against electric shock, separate breakers for outlets and lighting, 4 outlets (2 placed high – ready for an AC and internet), an LED light with a switch, and a waterproof single-phase connection. Needed if you want an AC.

ac.name: Inverter air conditioner
ac.description: A quiet, energy-efficient wall-mounted inverter AC, available only as an add-on to a shed.
ac.note: Installation not included. Best paired with the electrical panel.

choices.iska-1: Iska Inverter 1 HP (special offer with a shed)

vent-grill.name: Ventilation grill
vent-grill.description: For anyone who'd rather not have a fully sealed unit and wants fresh air flowing through.

wpc-floor.name: Premium WPC flooring
wpc-floor.description: A wood-polymer composite: the natural look of wood with high durability. 37 mm thick, with an insulating, sound-absorbing layer. Water-resistant – clean it with soap and water.
wpc-floor.note: ₪120 per m² including installation, by your shed's floor area · 5-year warranty

shelf-4.name: Everest 4-shelf unit
shelf-4.description: A metal frame with laminated wood shelves. Up to 120 kg per shelf. 96×40×183 cm.

shelf-5.name: Everest 5-shelf unit
shelf-5.description: A metal frame with laminated wood shelves. Up to 120 kg per shelf. 96×40×190.5 cm.
